drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a syncopated, palm-muted riff in E minor at 140 BPM. A second electric guitar provides melodic lead lines with wah-pedal filtering and pinch harmonics. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riff with a gritty, overdriven tone. Drums feature a prominent double-kick pedal pattern and heavy use of the ride cymbal bell. The arrangement follows a linear build-up with a breakdown section featuring a slowed, half-time drum feel and sustained power chords.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted syncopation]
[drum fill, snare-heavy]

[Main Section]
[full band enters, double-kick drumming]
[lead electric guitar with wah-wah effect]
[gritty overdriven bass guitar]

[Breakdown]
[half-time drum feel, crash cymbal accents]
[sustained power chords, feedback swell]

[Outro]
[accelerando drum roll]
[final distorted chord ring out]
